title: autonomy-weight.json
description: Every magnitude a mage's choice of WHICH node to work on is made of — the six term weights, the six per-term bounds, and the role x primitive appeal table. Vision §7 says mages act on utility-scored goals shaped by species, age, personality and their assigned standing role; this file is the shaping, as data rather than as literals in the rules path. Two kinds of record share the file: a scalar has neither `role` nor `primitive`, a role-appeal row has both and its id must be role-appeal-<role>-<primitive>. The *set* of scalar ids is structural — the rules read each by name and the loader rejects a set missing one or carrying an unknown one — while every *value* is an untuned placeholder awaiting the balance harness.
